record.original_question: What conditions on M , N and g imply boundary rigidity?

evidence.quote: What conditions on M , N and g imply boundary rigidity?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ and $(N,g')$ be compact Riemannian manifolds with boundary, and assume $\partial M$ is identified with $\partial N$ via a diffeomorphism. For a compact Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ with boundary, define the boundary distance function $d_g:\partial M\times\partial M\to[0,\infty)$ by letting $d_g(x,y)$ be the Riemannian distance between $x$ and $y$ in $M$. Recall that $(M,g)$ is called boundary rigid if whenever $(N,g')$ is another compact Riemannian manifold with boundary and a diffeomorphism $\varphi:\partial M\to\partial N$ satisfies $d_{g'}(\varphi(x),\varphi(y))=d_g(x,y)$ for all $x,y\in\partial M$, then $\varphi$ extends to a diffeomorphism $\Phi:M\to N$ with $\Phi^*g'=g$. A compact Riemannian manifold with boundary is called simple if its boundary is strictly convex and any two points are joined by a unique minimizing geodesic depending smoothly on the endpoints.

Determine geometric or analytic conditions on $M$, $N$, and the metric $g$ (for instance, conditions involving simplicity, curvature bounds, dimension, or proximity to model metrics) under which $(M,g)$ is boundary rigid. In particular, prove or disprove Michel's conjecture: every simple compact Riemannian manifold with boundary is boundary rigid.
artifact.status_search_result: Michel's boundary rigidity conjecture is proved in dimension 2 (Pestov–Uhlmann, 2005) and in special higher-dimensional cases (subdomains of $\mathbb{R}^n$ by Gromov; negatively curved symmetric spaces by Besson–Courtois–Gallot; metrics close to flat by Burago–Ivanov). Generic local rigidity and rigidity for manifolds satisfying certain curvature/foliation conditions are also known (Stefanov–Uhlmann, Stefanov–Uhlmann–Vasy). The full conjecture for simple manifolds in dimensions $\geq 3$ remains open.

status_evidence.title: Two dimensional compact simple Riemannian manifolds are boundary distance rigid
status_evidence.snippet: Pestov and Uhlmann prove boundary rigidity for 2D simple Riemannian manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is settled in dimension two.

status_evidence.title: Boundary rigidity and filling volume minimality of metrics close to a flat one
status_evidence.snippet: Burago–Ivanov establish boundary rigidity for metrics sufficiently close to a Euclidean metric.
status_evidence.claim: Higher-dimensional rigidity is known for metrics close to flat.

status_evidence.title: Boundary rigidity and stability for generic simple metrics
status_evidence.snippet: Stefanov–Uhlmann prove generic boundary rigidity and stability for simple metrics.
status_evidence.claim: Generic rigidity results are available, but the full conjecture is not.
